links.effect: Base diagnostic bias gap 45 percentage points; treatment gap 25 percentage points between high- and low-SES vignettes.
links.quote: In this experimental study of 480 responses from 6 large language models to paired high– vs low–socioeconomic status epilepsy vignettes, base diagnostic and treatment accuracies were 36% and 51%, respectively, with bias gaps of 45 and 25 percentage points, respectively; adding an inoculation prompt increased accuracy to 55% and 63% and reduced bias gaps to 27 and 8 percentage points, though effects varied by model, with some showing near-complete bias elimination and others demonstrating paradoxical worsening in certain conditions.

links.effect: Inoculation raised diagnosis accuracy 36% to 55% and treatment 51% to 63%; bias gaps fell 45 to 27 and 25 to 8 points, with model-specific worsening.
